summary: Iteration 5 verified: (1) Sr.DOM rename PASS, (2) Dashboard live auto-refresh KPI 3→4 PASS, (3) Notification bell reflects new blocks PASS, (4) Calendar timeline shows seeded blocks on 2026-08-18 PASS, (5) Admin User Management create+deactivate PASS, (6) Admin Corridor Settings add PASS, (7) Backend RBAC + corridor validation buckets + admin CRUD all PASS (12/12 pytest). One deviation: Free Slot Finder does NOT preserve slot list when user navigates away and returns without clicking Find again, so the requested 'auto-switch Available→Occupied on return' cannot fire.

integration_issues.flow: Free Slot Finder live refresh after new-block submit
integration_issues.issue: SlotFinder component state (slots list + hasRun flag) is discarded when the user navigates away to /new and returns to /slots. useLiveRefresh polling only runs when hasRun===true, and hasRun resets to false on remount, so the returning user sees an empty slot list until they click 'Find slots' again. The expected 10:00–12:00 Available→Occupied live update therefore does not occur on nav-back. Backend /api/slots correctly reports the new overlap (verified via pytest).

issues: 'Overall compliance' shows 400% because it appears to sum-instead-of-average all four compliance buckets; low priority but visually misleading.

action_items: Persist SlotFinder state across navigation OR auto-run find() on mount when a valid date+section+line combination exists, so that returning to /slots reflects the latest data without requiring another button click.
(Optional cosmetic) Fix Overall compliance percentage calculation on Dashboard (currently displays 400%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed() correctly upserts the Sr.DOM name on existing OFFICER001 without wiping data.

useLiveRefresh hook + 'rbms:refresh' event bus works for Dashboard, Notifications, Blocks list, Calendar and Analytics; only SlotFinder is state-bound to a manual Find click, which breaks the spec on cross-page navigation.
Admin endpoints correctly RBAC-guarded (data_entry→403, officer→403, admin→200) and exclude _id via projection.
Consider adding an index on blocks.date to keep dashboard/list queries fast as volume grows.
Deactivated user login is blocked at /api/auth/login with 403 as expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and 6/7 UI flows are green. Only remaining gap is Slot Finder auto-refresh across route navigation — main agent should either (a) auto-run find() on mount when defaults are set, or (b) hoist SlotFinder state to a parent/context so 'hasRun' survives remount. After fix, re-run the frontend Slot Finder segment only.
rca of the issue: SlotFinder in /app/frontend/src/App.js (~line 385) stores slots + hasRun in local component state; navigating to /new causes React to unmount the component, so hasRun becomes false on return. useLiveRefresh's polling callback checks hasRun and returns early, so no re-fetch occurs and the slot list is empty until the user clicks Find slots again. Backend GET /api/slots is fine (verified). Fix options: (1) auto-invoke find() in a useEffect on mount when date+section are present, (2) lift slots/hasRun into a top-level store or React Context so state persists across route changes, or (3) memoize the search params in URL and drive fetch from location.
